vb_textbox.text: In my experience the gnomes with the long hat tended to get more mushrooms. When the numbers of mushrooms that I received with the long hat gnome started to decrease, I would switch to the gnome with the small hat. So my suggestion would be that if  a particular hat shape seems to be profitable, stick with it until it starts to diminish and then you can just swap to to the other hat. Hope this advice was helpful, good luck!!
